text: 管线 qwen3.7-max 跑 sealed blind v6 240 条，pipeline 含 4 阶段：one_pass_generation_with_v21_prompt, gold_free_high_precision_query_output_assertions, assertion_gated_reason_specific_repair_v7, deterministic_where_canonicalization
门控后 Where 234/240, Schema 238/240, compiler-hard 232/240; 额外 API 调用 8/240, 修复 5 条、破坏 0 条
v21 and v7 were developed after blind-v5 reveal; these are post-hoc development results, not untouched evidence.
next_required_experiment: No further prompt tuning on blind-v6. Add a mandatory schema-validation retry at the production boundary, then distill the validated strong pipeline into the 4B student.
600 逐题审计：222 Where 失败主归因 + 440 Semantic 失败；当前计算 222/440/600（intersection=62）
5 类主归因 M/R/P/G/F 定义见 aux/error_codes.json；本审计 no_api_calls / no_gpu_inference / no_gold_changes / no_score_changes
291 步完整连续；日志 loss 与梯度无 NaN/Inf；checkpoint-200 与最终 adapter 各 496 张量；无误开 thinking、混用 4B 权重或中断证据
checkpoint-200 vs 最终 blind 持平（Where 198/240, compiler-hard 209/240），Where 逐题 4 修 4 退化，总分持平。 不支持最后 91 步整体退化，但不能排除 200 步前过拟合。
